descriptions.LumA: Luminal A: hormone receptor rich, low proliferation, best prognosis, endocrine sensitive.
descriptions.LumB: Luminal B: hormone receptor positive with high proliferation; benefits more often from chemotherapy.
descriptions.Her2: HER2 enriched: driven by the ERBB2 amplicon; candidate for HER2 targeted therapy.
descriptions.Basal: Basal like: mostly triple negative, high grade, chemotherapy sensitive, early relapse risk.
descriptions.claudin-low: Claudin low: low cell adhesion genes, immune and stem cell features, usually triple negative.
descriptions.Normal: Normal like: resembles normal breast tissue; often reflects low tumour content in the sample.
